en:
I already know, Shuichi!
You don't have to say anything!
Huh? What are you talking about?

You've taken an interest in Neo-Aikido,
right?
...No, not really.

Don't worry!
Neo-Aikido accepts degenerate males, too!

Our goal is to become the national sport.
Necessity knows no law!

<CLT=cltMIND>Her expression says that
she doesn't want to.

First, I will teach you how to mentally
prepare yourself for Neo-Aikido!

Neo-Aikido requires heavy amounts of
action, so please take caution!

Practice is not enough!
You must experience actual combat as well!

So then, Shuichi!
Get ready for a sparring match!

W-Wait! I can't just start fighting!
Don't I need to know the basics first!?

Whaaat?
There's no such thing as "basics" in Neo-Aikido!

Would swinging a bamboo sword in the air help
you win in Kendo?

Likewise, would swinging a bat in the air help
you hit a homerun in baseball?
I guess not...

The only way you can improve is to fight an
actual battle. That's the true form of practice!
I see. That's probably for the best.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is starting to make sense...
Maybe Neo-Aikido isn't as weird as I thought.

Shuichi, you're starting to look more
interested now.

Then, I will tell you the special secret
of Neo-Aikido!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Maybe I spoke too soon.

As practitioners of Neo-Aikido,
Master and I...
...are also heroes of justice!

Master and I wear masks to disguise ourselves!
We serve to save, whether it is day or night!
Is the mask important?
Isn't that embarrassing?
Ah...like superheroes...
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltMIND>Heroes of justice?
Is the mask important?

Yes, Master said so!
Heroes of justice must wear fashionable masks!

That way, no one will know our true identities!
Master said it's required for a hero of justice!
<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe in comic books...but in real life?
Isn't that embarrassing?

Why should we be embarrassed!?
We're doing a good deed!

Protect the weak and beat the strong!
We crush evil and care for the poor!

Aaaaahhhh!!! We're so cool!!!
Master's ideas are always so stellar!
Ah...like superheroes...

Hahaha, are you surprised?
Heroes of justice are real!

Oh! But you're the only one I told this to, so
don't go around telling other people, okay?

If people find out Neo-Aikido practitioners are
superheroes, too many males will wanna join!

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought you wanted to
spread it around the world...

So what kind of work does a
"hero of justice" do?
We do everything!

Help an old woman carry her belongings...
Help a child cross the street...

Oh, yeah!
I caught a thief the other day!
I see... You work pretty hard.

We also punish degenerates who cheat,
bring divine justice to gropers on trains...

And even help girls who just had
tough break-ups!

Is that really under the purview
of heroes of justice?

Of course! Nothing is more wretched than
seeing a girl cry over a male!

Sometimes, we teach the girls Neo-Aikido
to help them exact their revenge on males!
Revenge!? Isn't that a little excessive?

What are you talking about!? It's those
degenerates' fault for making girls cry!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder...how many men have been
taken out by Neo-Aikido...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tenko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Still trying to figure out heroes
of justice, I returned to my room...
